verdicts.reason: A keeps the overlay panel running off the bottom edge and keeps the X/slash/circle marks at the panel's corners like the original, with a clean centred text stack. Its flaws: the marks are tight against the panel edges and half-cross them, the top of the canvas feels cramped, and the type sits smaller in a shrunken frame. B cuts the panel off at about 255 px, which leaves a stray strip of photo under it and makes it look unfinished. B's corner marks float well outside the narrower panel over busy hands, so they no longer frame anything. Its headline and the 'Join WADE team' line are also smaller and weaker than A's.
